title: Peujabat Apui Nyang Hana Padam .
intro: Saboh tokoh teudong bak ambang teumpat nyang paleng teumakot di alam ghaib, geubri amanah deungon saboh tugaih nyang hana geutem le makhluk laen. Watee jiwa-jiwa nyang meudeurita jimeuhôi jilakée rahmat, saboh tanggapan nyang teuga meu-gema lam kama-kama apui. Jeut neubuka identitas wali abadi nyoe?
clues: Lon dong bak pinto tamong teumpat hukoman nyang teumakot di alam ghaib.
Apui nyang meu-apui-apui nyang hana meu-ulang-ulang na kheueh pusat nibak tugaih ulôn nyang suci.
Jiwa-jiwa nyang meudeurita jikheun nan ulôn, jilakée peuleupah nibak siksaan awaknyan nyang hana akhé.
Watèë awaknjan djimeulakèë, ulôn peugah bahwa awaknjan hana djitinggai, siumu masa.
Lon kon manusia, kon jin — lon nakeuh makhluk ciptaan nyang murni ta’at.
Lon nakeuh malaikat utama nyang geutunyok seubagoe peunjaga abadi apui nuraka.

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
